add.issue.name: P1: URL reads bypass network approval and restore secrets into requests

edit.description.md: Baseline: reproduced on published v0.7.1; verify the local fork before patching. ReadTool declares read-only effects but HTTP(S) inputs perform GET requests. Under always-ask, the receiver obtained a restored dummy credential from a URL query without approval. Source: src/tools.rs ReadTool::effects/execute, src/agent.rs restore_secrets_inbound, src/approval.rs pure-read auto-approval. Acceptance: classify URL reads as network effects; deny them without an approval surface; test an explicit approved request and placeholder handling. Full local evidence: local-review/rust-adversarial-review.md and rust-review-evidence/.

add.issue.name: P2: Hostname resolution bypasses URL private-address guard

edit.description.md: Baseline: reproduced on v0.7.1. Literal loopback was blocked, but the machine hostname resolving to 127.0.1.1 reached a harmless local service with default policy. Source: src/url_read.rs host_is_private_target/fetch_with_redirects. Verify local fork first. Acceptance: validate resolved destination IPs, pin the validated peer while preserving Host/TLS identity, and test hostname and redirect routes. Transport rejected tested userinfo and IPv4-mapped IPv6 variants; do not claim those as working exploits.

add.issue.name: P2: Extension tools bypass write-mode process approval

edit.description.md: Baseline: reproduced on v0.7.1. Direct bash is denied under approval-mode write, while an installed extension tool with permissive execution capability ran Python and wrote a harmless marker without a prompt. Source: src/extension_tools.rs wrappers, src/tools.rs default Tool::effects, src/approval.rs write mode. Verify local fork first. Acceptance: require accurate effects or conservative executable defaults and bind sensitive hostcalls to actual approval. Safe extension profile blocked the direct exec/eval negative control.

add.issue.name: P1: Interrupt exits before child commands stop

edit.description.md: Baseline: repeatedly reproduced on v0.7.1. Run bash: printf started > started.txt; (sleep 5; printf orphan > marker.txt) & wait. After started.txt appears, send SIGINT to agent. Agent exits as aborted in about 0.06 seconds; marker.txt still appears later. Source hazard: src/tools.rs ProcessGuard::Drop performs detached cleanup; exact release lifecycle attribution requires instrumentation. Verify local fork first. Acceptance: signal owned group before dropping ownership, complete bounded cleanup before exit, and test already-exited shells plus descendants. See local-review/rust_adversarial_tests.py.

add.issue.name: P2: Qualify self-update crash durability and rollback failures

edit.description.md: Source-only finding; no runtime reproduction yet. src/self_update.rs perform_atomic_swap uses two renames with a missing-executable window, flush without full fsync durability, ignored rollback rename failures, and an unbounded new-binary version probe. Acceptance: test interrupted publication/failed rollback/hung version probe against disposable fixture executables; make publication durable and bound smoke checks. Do not test on the installed agent.
